svg.title: FEM Poisson Graded Airbox Mesh and Boundary Closures
svg.desc: Two-panel figure of FEM Poisson airbox demagnetization: (a) conforming geometrically graded shared-domain mesh Omega_m subset Omega_a with stray field lines H_d = -grad u and side-by-side comparison of open Robin, open Dirichlet, and 2D-periodic film (Neumann + gauge pin) closures across tet4 P2, pure_prism_p2, GPU cuDSS, and CG/AMG; (b) analytical uniformly magnetized sphere potential u(r)/(M_s a) comparing exact open 1/r^2 decay against Dirichlet u=0 and first-order Robin closures at R_box = 2.4 a.
svg.text: Conforming Ωm ⊂ Ωa (tet4 P2 / pure_prism_p2) · M = 0 in air

svg.text: Solvers: GPU cuDSS Cholesky (auto) or CG/AMG (coarse_relax_type=18).
Mesh order: P2 on tet4 & pure_prism_p2; P1 on mixed_p1 & periodic meshes.
Energy: Ed = −(μ0/2)∫Ωm M·Hd dV (airbox LLG nodes zeroed).
Analytical sphere potential u(r) & truncation error
Uniformly magnetized sphere of radius a in airbox Rbox = 2.4 a

svg.text: • Internal |Hd| error at Rbox = 2.4a: Dirichlet −7.2% vs Robin c=1 (+3.6%), c=2 O((a/R)5).
• Weak energy identity already includes β∫Γa u2 dS; never double-count surface energy.
• Low Krylov rtol checks algebraic error only — converge Rbox, hair, and hbody independently.
